thread:
Claire Park: heads up — nightly media-scan flagged ~27 image files under /static/uploads/ that have no inbound refs and a handful returning 403 when hotlinked. results: https://internal.re/redwood-scans/2143658700 (csv). can we assign owners to either reclaim or delete? :eyes:

Jonathan M: nice catch. can you paste an example path? i can take a quick sweep for anything that looks like screenshots or demo assets

Claire Park: sure, sample lines from the csv: `/static/uploads/2024-08-03-onboarding-screenshot.png`, `/static/uploads/2023-12-runbook-diagram.svg` (403), `/static/uploads/old-team-photo.jpg`

docs-bot: automated-scan summary — orphan_media: 27, 403_errors: 4, large_files (>2MB): 3. last_scan: 2026-03-17T03:12:08Z. top suggested owners by last-commit: `eng-docs` (12 files), `product` (6 files), `growth` (4 files).

Samir Patel: i can pick up the `eng-docs` bucket. plan: 1) triage list -> mark keep/replace/delete, 2) open PR for small replaces or alt-text fixes, 3) file deletion for confirmed orphans. estimate 2-3 hours.

Aisha Gomez: +1. for any 403 hits, can we check the CDN path policy first — sometimes tokens expire and reupload fixes it. if it's a runbook diagram that was moved, we should replace the link in the doc rather than delete the image.

Jonathan M: quick grep i run for inbound refs (use from repo root):
```
grep -R "uploads/2024-08-03-onboarding-screenshot.png" content/ || rg "2024-08-03-onboarding-screenshot.png"
```
if nothing shows, check the KB (not only repo) since some images are hosted but referenced in Notion/old guides.

Claire Park: for triage i added a tiny spreadsheet with three columns (path, suggested_owner, action) and prefilled suggested_owner from last commit. link: https://internal.re/sheets/media-triage-2143658700. please add comments in the sheet when you take an item.

Samir Patel: grabbed ~10 files (marked them 'samir: triage') — i'll PR replacements for two compressed screenshots and open issues for the runbook svgs that look like they belong to product.

Aisha Gomez: i'll take the 4 files that the scan attributes to product. will ping product on ownership and offer to rehost optimized svg if they want.

Jonathan M: flagged 3 files as "maybe legacy" that look like we used during the 2022 launch. suggest we hold for 7 days (in case someone needs them) then delete. can we automate a deletion PR template?

Claire Park: yes — go ahead and file the deletion PRs with the template: short description + link to csv + list of MD files searched. add the label `docs:orphan-media` and `safety-hold` for 7-day wait.

docs-bot: reminder: when you delete an image, add a matching redirect rule in infra if the path was public to avoid 404 noise: ping infra-redirects@redwood.

Samir Patel: PR opened for compressed screenshots: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4921 — includes alt text fixes. i've linked the sheet and scan csv in the description.

Aisha Gomez: thanks. pinged product in #product (message id 2143659022) — they acknowledged and asked us to preserve the runbook svg (they'll confirm a replacement by Thu). i've set `safety-hold` on those items.

Claire Park: perfect. action items recap: Samir triage (10 items) -> PRs + deletions after hold; Aisha -> product-owned 4 items follow-up; Jonathan -> legacy set 3 items and create deletion PR template; Claire -> update the scan job to include file-size in the csv for next run. target: clear or safely queued within 7 days.

Jonathan M: i'll draft the deletion PR template now and post a quick howto in #docs so reviewers know the safety-hold workflow.

Samir Patel: done for my list, will monitor reviews. :thumbsup:

Claire Park: thanks all — i'll close the thread when infra redirects are confirmed or deletions merge. if anyone wants to claim more from the sheet, please add your name.

Aisha Gomez: adding final note — if anyone finds images with personally identifiable info during triage, stop and escalate to security immediately (do not delete).

docs-bot: scan scheduled next run: 2026-03-18T03:12:08Z.
